claims: Ripple says its products enabled more than $16T in transactions during 2025.
Ripple says it is on track to exit 2026 with $900M annualized product revenue run rate; this is a forward run-rate statement.
Ripple Payments is approaching $150B lifetime volume by year-end and serves 60+ payout markets.
Ripple reports 85+ licenses, 1,700+ institutional/corporate/enterprise customers and RLUSD around $2.6B market cap.
limitations: $16T covers the broader product portfolio, not XRP-routed payment volume.
$150B Ripple Payments lifetime volume does not mean all flows use XRP.
$900M is a projected annualized run rate, not audited 2026 revenue.
